propositions: LLM reply parsing currently fails when schema-valid decoys or fence-wrapped quoted material precede the intended JSON payload, causing wrong object selection.

An explicit output channel using line-anchored sentinel markers (`<<<REBAR_OUTPUT>>>` / `<<<END>>>`) must be added to `schema_directive` and extraction logic to make payload location a stated contract rather than inference.

Marker extraction must implement last-block-wins semantics via reverse-order iteration and fail-closed error handling: valid payload wins; if all blocks invalid, raise the last block's error instead of falling through to decoy selection.
Markerless replies (no complete marker block pairs) must fall through byte-for-byte unchanged to the existing schema-filtered selection pipeline to preserve backward compatibility.
The bounded-retry prompt in `structured_run.py` must name the same markers as the first attempt to keep the fail-closed retry channel consistent and prevent contradiction between directive attempts.
